description.value:
An oversized Battleglove over hand and forearm; that hand can't do anything else. Two built-in Popup Ranged Weapon mounts (guns bought separately, swappable with DV17 Weaponstech and 4 hours) and one more cyberarm or cyberlimb option slot (no cyberhands or hand options). Brawling and Martial Arts with that arm are at −4. On or off is an Action; it blocks options in the arm underneath. Not concealable.

Cost: 3,000eb (Luxury)

Item Compendium (2070) • Gear & Goods
